niche_statement: Governance-focused fractional CTO for growth-stage independent and charter schools (~800-2,000 students) whose boards cannot answer technology-risk questions -- schools that outgrew reactive outsourced IT with no technology leadership -- delivering a 90-day board-level cybersecurity/AI/vendor-governance clarity plan without replacing existing IT vendors, plus proven legacy-PBX-to-Microsoft-Teams-Phone rescues (~50% telephony cost cuts at 300+ users).
edp: A tuition-funded school with no technology governance recovers from a vendor breach in weeks instead of days in front of tuition-paying families; ~5% enrollment attrition at 800-2,000 students is roughly $0.6M-$3M of annual tuition -- more than most independent schools' entire operating margin (estimate).
expertise_statements: Serve as the school's first dedicated technology leader, reporting to the Head of School and board of trustees
Oversee our managed IT services provider and hold technology vendors accountable for deliverables and cost
Develop a multi-year technology plan aligned to enrollment growth across campuses
Present technology risk, cybersecurity posture, and budget updates to the board of trustees
Develop and enforce policies for responsible AI use by faculty and students
Build cybersecurity incident response and data-breach communication plans for student and family data
Ensure FERPA/COPPA compliance and student data privacy across all school systems and vendor contracts
Administer and integrate the student information system (Blackbaud, Veracross, PowerSchool, FACTS)
Review technology vendor contracts before auto-renewal and negotiate pricing and service levels
Migrate our aging Avaya / on-premise PBX phone system to a cloud-based platform
Deploy and administer Microsoft Teams Phone, Operator Connect, or Direct Routing telephony
Consolidate redundant technology vendors and reduce overall IT spend
Administer Microsoft 365, endpoint management, and hybrid cloud infrastructure across multiple sites
Create IT policies, SOP documentation, and knowledge base where none currently exist
Coordinate technology operations and support across multiple school campuses
Translate technical and cybersecurity risk into plain language for non-technical leadership
Stand up IT and network operations for a new facility or organization launch
Manage WAN/LAN/wireless network infrastructure across distributed sites (Cisco, Aruba, Fortinet)
